name: Xarlok Empire
role: External militant expansionist power on the Galactic Union frontier
description: A militant, expansionist empire — described in source as a militant species with expansionist ambitions — that frequently challenges Galactic Union borders. It is treated by the Union as a standing external threat: a rationale for maintaining a strong deterrent fleet, a target of Union espionage and surveillance, and a power that (alongside pirates and rogue states) might exploit any perceived Union weakness to attack trade routes.
